# Resumly

> Free AI-powered resume builder for freshers and job seekers in India. Create ATS-friendly resumes in minutes — no login, no payment.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Free AI resume builder — ATS-friendly, no login.
- [Resume Builder](/builder): Step-by-step AI resume builder.
- [ATS Checker](/ats-checker): Score your resume against ATS systems.
- [Resume Templates](/resume-templates): Gallery of free ATS-friendly resume templates.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How we handle your data.
